verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official CLI for local development and terminal deploys. Its agent docs tie the CLI to AI-native workflows: one command installs the CLI and configures skills, MCP and authentication, and a probe confirms the CLI guide exists. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of the CLI's command coverage (e.g. variables, logs, environments) and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.
Install the Railway CLI and configure agent support — skills, MCP, and authentication — in one command.
